success.description: # You pick up your quarry’s scent and gain a clear impression of the direction he has gone.

As above, and until the next moonrise, you keep a memory of the subject’s scent. You add {Dc} to the dice pool to further attempts to find or follow your quarry. (You can only hold one quarry’s scent at a time)

boon.description: # You learn a piece of information about your quarry that can be conveyed by scent, such as his race or gender, recently he passed by, or whether he was wounded or ill.

conservative.requirements: 3 favour, Strength 3+. You cannot follow any trail older than 1 week. If the trail you are following is more than a day old, add {Dc} to the dice pool.
